what_it_does: This paper evaluates the SENSE system, which uses intent-based software-defined networking (network control via software rather than hardware alone) to guarantee reliable, secure data movement for large-scale scientific workflows that span multiple computer centers. Scientific computing workflows often move data across institutional boundaries where predictable network performance is critical. The work measures real end-to-end benefits by testing on actual testbeds including the Great Plains Network, National Research Platform, FABRIC, and production Large Hadron Collider infrastructure.
